name: RJ Wood Industries
old_description: Establish a customer base of repeat and long-lasting partnerships based on integrity and trust. Provide a superior product that is on time and cost effective. Encourage a team work environment, where we depend on each other and contribute to one another’s success. Invest in our growth through technology and innovation.
about:
RJ Wood Industries operates from Jackson, Wisconsin, a village in Washington County northwest of Milwaukee. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials.

The shop produces custom millwork, retail fixtures, and commercial cabinetry, offering a full suite of services that spans engineering, drafting, manufacturing, in-house finishing, installation, and project management. It positions itself as a turn-key provider, handling projects from design through on-site assembly, with an emphasis on efficient installation methods that reduce field labor and keep schedules on track. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers come from retail, commercial construction, banking, healthcare, and trade-show sectors. Retail work includes showcases, cash wraps, point-of-purchase displays, back-of-house fixtures, and perimeter store fixtures. Commercial projects cover build-outs, reception counters, factory-built walls, casework, trim packages, computer centers, and conference tables. The company also supplies bank fixtures and cabinetry, nurses stations, and custom trade-show exhibits with crating.

RJ Wood stresses that its people and partnership approach set it apart, citing strategic customer relationships and project management as core differentiators. The firm says its construction methods yield a better final product and more efficient on-site installation, delivering a cost-effective millwork package without sacrificing quality.
